name: Andrew
ability: You start knowing which Demon is in play.

name: Bryce
ability: You start knowing if you neighbour a Townsfolk.
firstNightReminder: Nod if either neighbour is a Townsfolk; shake your head if not.

name: Hannah
ability: You start knowing how many steps from a non-Townsfolk to its nearest non-Townsfolk. You learn if this changes.
firstNightReminder: Give a finger signal: the number of steps between the 2 non-Townsfolk sitting closest together.
otherNightReminder: If the number has changed since the Hannah last learned it, give the new number.

name: Jess
ability: You start knowing if there are more evil players clockwise or anti-clockwise of you. If equal, this info is arbitrary. You learn if this changes.
otherNightReminder: If the answer has changed since the Jess last learned it, point in the new direction.

name: CJ
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): if they vote tomorrow, but only when you vote, they are safe from the Demon that night.
firstNightReminder: The CJ chooses a player: mark them CHOSEN.
otherNightReminder: If yesterday's CHOSEN player voted at least once, and only when the CJ voted, mark them SAFE. The CJ chooses a player: mark them CHOSEN.

name: Connor
ability: Each night*, choose a player: learn if their character's name starts with A–M or N–Z.
otherNightReminder: The Connor chooses a player. Point up for A–M, down for N–Z.

name: Maura
ability: Each night*, if you nominated yourself today, you learn how many of the players who voted were evil.
otherNightReminder: If the Maura nominated themself today, give a finger signal: how many voters were evil.

name: Sarah
ability: Each night*, answer a yes/no question. If correct, you learn an in-play character; if not, you are drunk until dusk.
otherNightReminder: Ask the Sarah a yes/no question about the game. Show them a character token either way. If they answered wrong, they are drunk until dusk and the token may be false.

name: Jon
ability: Each day, if you are mad that you are a character, that night you learn if that character voted on you that day.
otherNightReminder: If the Jon was mad about a character today, nod if that character voted on the Jon.

name: Ben
ability: Each day, 1 living player may secretly become a Ben, if the starting Ben agrees. If all living good players are Ben and no Ben is evil, good wins.

name: Alex
ability: Once per game, you may play any real-life card: it takes effect in the game. An evil player also has this ability.
firstNightReminder: Wake the chosen evil player: show them the Alex token and tell them they also have this ability. Mark them GAINS ABILITY.

name: David
ability: You think you are an out-of-play Outsider, but you are not.

name: JFK
ability: The Minions think you are the Demon. If you die, the Minions learn who the Demon is.
firstNightReminder: During Minion info, point to the JFK as the Demon instead of the real Demon.
otherNightReminder: If the JFK died since dawn, wake the Minions and point to the real Demon.

name: John K
ability: You start knowing an in-play character. If someone is mad that they are that character, you might be executed, even if dead.
firstNightReminder: Show the John K an in-play character token.

name: Mason
ability: Each night, choose a living player: if they are an Outsider, you become that Outsider. If they are a Minion, you turn evil. You are drunk on every other night.
firstNightReminder: The Mason chooses a player. If the Mason is drunk tonight, nothing happens. Otherwise: if an Outsider, the Mason becomes that Outsider (show them the token); if a Minion, the Mason turns evil (tell them).
otherNightReminder: The Mason chooses a player. If the Mason is drunk tonight, nothing happens. Otherwise: if an Outsider, the Mason becomes that Outsider (show them the token); if a Minion, the Mason turns evil (tell them).

name: Puzzles
ability: Once per day, if an evil player is mad about being an evil character, they gain that character's ability until dusk tomorrow.

name: Jeff
ability: If the dead equal or outnumber the living, you change alignment.
otherNightReminder: If the dead now equal or outnumber the living, and the Jeff is alive and hasn't changed yet, wake the Jeff and tell them their new alignment.

name: Mitchell
ability: All Townsfolk that vote on you are drunk until dusk tomorrow, even if dead.

name: Sam
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, they are mad that the other is an Outsider, or one or both might die. [+1 Outsider]
firstNightReminder: The Sam chooses 2 players. Wake both together and show them the Sam token.
otherNightReminder: If yesterday's MAD players broke madness, one or both might die. The Sam chooses 2 players. Wake both together and show them the Sam token.

name: Stephen
ability: Each night*, learn the character of the first player to nominate an evil player today. Once per game, you may poison until dusk or kill that player.
otherNightReminder: Show the Stephen the character of the first player to nominate an evil player today. Once per game, the Stephen may poison them until dusk or kill them.

name: Haley
ability: Each day, if you are mad about being a character, that night that character is poisoned and you register as it.
otherNightReminder: If the Haley was mad about a character today, mark that character POISONED until dusk; the Haley registers as it.

name: Lauren
ability: Once per game, at night, choose 3 players (at least 1 good): their characters rotate one seat clockwise among them. Alignments stay with players.
firstNightReminder: The Lauren may choose 3 players. If so, rotate their character tokens clockwise among those 3 and wake each to show their new token.
otherNightReminder: The Lauren may choose 3 players. If so, rotate their character tokens clockwise among those 3 and wake each to show their new token.

name: Kane
ability: Each night, choose a player: if they vote on an evil player tomorrow, they die that night. Once per game, choose 2 players instead.
firstNightReminder: The Kane chooses 1 player (or 2, once per game): mark them CHOSEN.
otherNightReminder: Each CHOSEN player who voted on an evil player today dies. The Kane chooses 1 player (or 2, once per game): mark them CHOSEN.

name: Bobbi
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The first player you vote on becomes an Outsider that night. [-1 Outsider]
otherNightReminder: The Bobbi chooses a player: they die. If this is the first night after the Bobbi voted, the first player they voted on becomes an Outsider: wake them to show the token.

name: Pam
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you did not vote today, also choose a player: they are poisoned until dusk.
otherNightReminder: The Pam chooses a player: they die. If the Pam did not vote today, they choose another player: mark them POISONED.

name: chäse
ability: Each night*, choose a player and a character: they die. If you guessed their character correctly, choose another player: they die.
otherNightReminder: The chäse chooses a player and a character: that player dies. If the character was correct, the chäse chooses another player: they die.

name: Colls
ability: Each night*, choose a player: if they agree, you may speak with them privately for a few moments.
otherNightReminder: The Colls chooses a player. If they agree, let them talk privately for a moment.

name: Lex
ability: Each day, publicly name a player: if they are executed, you learn their character that night.
otherNightReminder: If the Lex's named player was executed today, show their character token.

name: Darragh
ability: Each day, you may swap seats with a player and publicly make a statement about them. Tonight, learn if your statement was true.
otherNightReminder: If the Darragh made a statement today, nod if it was true.

name: Trina
ability: Once per game, choose a player: they see the Grimoire. If either of you are mad about the demon, your team loses.
firstNightReminder: The Trina may choose a player: show them the Grimoire.
otherNightReminder: The Trina may choose a player: show them the Grimoire.

name: Potato Jim
ability: Your vote counts as 2.
